description: Fetches official Brazilian municipality statistics from IBGE (Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística) including population, area, demographics, and administrative data using the public API.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - search_municipalities: Search for municipalities by name (requires: query); 参数: query; 必填: 无
  - get_municipality: Get municipality details by ID (requires: municipality_id); 参数: municipality_id; 必填: 无
  - get_municipality_statistics: Get statistics for a municipality (requires: municipality_id); 参数: municipality_id; 必填: 无
  - get_municipality_full: Get complete data including location and statistics (requires: municipality_id); 参数: municipality_id; 必填: 无
  - get_state_municipalities: Get all municipalities for a state (requires: state); 参数: state; 必填: 无
  - get_states: Get all Brazilian states (no additional params required); 参数: 无; 必填: 无

query.description: Search query for municipality name (used by search_municipalities)

municipality_id.description: IBGE municipality ID (7-digit code, e.g., 5215801 for Palmelo-GO)

state.description: Brazilian state abbreviation (e.g., GO, SP, RJ) for get_state_municipalities
